statement: Saudi Arabia or the Saudi-led coalition conducts at least one air or missile strike on a target in Houthi-held Yemen between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC or Al Jazeera report a Saudi or coalition air or missile strike on a target in Houthi-held Yemen occurring between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-25 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Saudi or coalition air or missile strike on a target in Houthi-held Yemen takes place between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-25.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
